info.title: Wealth Master API
info.description: Session authentication, mandatory production MFA, accounts, calculated cash balances, manual income/expenses/refunds, and same-currency paired transfers. Current net worth by native currency, including archived account cash balances. User-owned two-level income/spending categories and optional ledger assignment. Dated normal monthly/yearly limits, specific-period exceptions, native currency actuals and explicit exception copying. Spending distribution reports show expenses before refunds and exact net spending independently of limits.

post.summary: Create transactions
post.description: Dates between account opening and today in APP_BUSINESS_TIME_ZONE. Active owned accounts required. Transfers require distinct accounts with matching currencies. Negative resulting balances allowed. Refunds reduce spending; transfers are excluded from income/spending. Transfer edits/deletions change both movements atomically.

get.summary: Calculate current net worth for the authenticated owner
get.description: One repeatable-read snapshot of opening balances plus non-deleted ledger movements. Positive balances are assets; negative balances are liabilities. Includes archived accounts and investment cash, excludes future-opening accounts. Native currencies remain separate; no FX conversion or security valuation. Business date uses APP_BUSINESS_TIME_ZONE. Read-only; no CSRF token required.

get.description: One read-only repeatable-read snapshot, owner-scoped and no-store. Includes every spending category and archived activity; excludes deleted operations, income, transfers and opening balances. Gross expenses and refunds remain separate; net spending drives limits. Direct amounts belong to the assigned category; inclusive amounts add immediate children. Pie uses root inclusive expenses plus uncategorized, counting each expense once. No budgets are required. Effective comparisons include dated defaults, period exceptions and accrued monthly totals; usage dates and business date are explicit. Activity is capped at the business date.
